*   **Cracks:** If nodes are split with uniform size around the surface but varying depths exist around the isosurface, cracks (boundaries) will appear in the resulting mesh [S2].

The claim states that if nodes are split with uniform size around the surface but varying depths exist around the isosurface, cracks will appear. The evidence in Source [S2] explicitly states: 'it is sure to produce cracks if you have varying depths around the isosurface.' Additionally, Figure 65.9 description confirms that the mesh exhibits cracks at regions where octree levels are discontinuous (varying depths).
